# Rename Sweep

Script companion to `.claude/rules/rename-safety.md`. Renames are this repo's
highest-risk change (the Manuscript→Scorecard rename shipped an outage via missed
string literals). Don't reason through the grep variants by hand — run the script;
it is deterministic and cheaper than model reasoning.

## Usage

```bash
# Step 1 — full-reference inventory BEFORE editing anything (lists every hit):
.claude/skills/rename-sweep/check.sh inventory manuscript manuscripts

# Step 3 — verification gate BEFORE merge (exit 1 on any hit outside
# CHANGELOG and database/migrations):
.claude/skills/rename-sweep/check.sh gate manuscript manuscripts
```

- Names in **kebab-case**; each matches kebab, snake, camel, Pascal, and
  space-separated variants case-insensitively.
- Pass **singular and plural separately** — they are different strings.
- Excludes `node_modules`, `vendor`, lockfiles, `dist`, `public/build`, `storage`.

## When to invoke

- Before starting any rename (entity, route, store, feature, table, env var):
  `inventory` mode produces the layer-by-layer hit list the rename-safety rule
  requires you to confirm before editing.
- Before merging a rename: `gate` mode must exit 0, alongside `make lint` and the
  full test suites.

## What it does NOT do

- Catch serialized data already in the DB/queue (job class names, polymorphic
  `*_type` rows) — those need the migration steps in the rename-safety rule.
- Replace the smoke test of the renamed API path end-to-end.
